master.description: The Fleet Cross-Training shoes provide an ideal platform for high-mileage runners looking for 1 pair of shoes to take them from the street to the trail and back again.
master.features: Quicklace_ lacing system takes just 1 pull for a perfect fit; lace pocket hides lacing away Protective toe and heel caps guard against bumps and abrasion frames run along the soles of the shoes to facilitate better heel-to-toe transitions Triple-density EVA midsoles isolate you from trail impacts, and thermoplastic urethane inserts provide a barrier against sharp rocks underfoot
master.name: Fleet Cross-Training Shoe
master.reviews: By ohsooocute from Reseda, Ca I do lots of trail walking in the San Gabriel Mountains. These shoes were comfortable from the start. I like the quick lacing system because my shoes stay tied the way I want from the start. They are lightweight, yet sturdy. Thanks mum for thr great birthday present.
